Switching back to ordinary USB takes effect after a restart. Restart now?
Set to MTP, effective after a restart

Notes:
• Sample rate, volume and mute are all chosen on the computer (macOS Audio MIDI Setup / Windows Sound settings).
• 44.1 / 48 / 88.2 / 96 / 176.4 / 192 / 352.8 / 384 kHz at 24 bit, switched without replugging.
• The player's volume is driven by the computer; the slider is the ZX500 hardware volume.
• The ceiling is how loud a full computer volume slider gets. Default 100; Sony's scale ends at 120.
• A changed ceiling applies the next time DAC mode starts.
• If the computer does not notice DAC mode, unplug and replug the cable once.
• Switching to MTP needs a restart.
• On first use, grant this app root in KernelSU.
